Cyclo-Vets Saturday Ride

San Diego, CA · Mission Valley · Road

No-drop

Cyclo-Vets Saturday Ride is a road group ride in San Diego, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:30 am from Trader Joe's / Coffee Bean lot, Mission Valley. About 35–50 miles, a (hilly, ~50 mi), B+ (~40 mi, no-drop), B Top Gun (~35 mi, mostly flat).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a (hilly, ~50 mi), B+ (~40 mi, no-drop), B Top Gun (~35 mi, mostly flat). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cyclo-Vets Saturday Ride group ride

A recreational club that started in 1984 for older riders and now takes all ages. Three Saturday groups leave Mission Valley together; the B rides are no-drop. Approved e-bikes are allowed. There is also a Friday leisurely ferry-and-bikeway ride from Coronado.
